textDisplay: Judging by the comments below, I'm probably in the minority here when I say this, but I'm not as gung-ho for GOTG this time around. I don't know..... this movie just feels too "Disney-fied" to me. I mean, did they really have to make Groot that small & that young? It feels like they're telling us they will be intentionally pandering ​to audiences this time around with an absurdly cute baby Groot. While I'm anxious to see what the next entry into the MCU will be as they methodically continue to set the table for Infinity War, I've cringed at the sight of Dave Bautista camping it up out there in all of these trailers. As a former WWE wrestler he's a ham actor to begin with, and it looks like he's trying too hard to be the comedy relief now. I hope they disprove my suspicions, but as of now I'm​ lowering my expectations a notch.
